articles.title: PrBIMZELX® (bimekizumab injection) approved in Canada for treatment of moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS)
articles.mainIdea: PrBIMZELX® (bimekizumab injection) approved in Canada for treatment of moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS)
articles.summary: CNW Group: PrBIMZELX® (bimekizumab injection) approved in Canada for treatment of moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS). UCB Canada Inc. is pleased to announce Health Canada has granted a Notice of Compliance (NOC) for PrBIMZELX® (bimekizumab injection) indicated for the treatment of adult patients with moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) with an inadequate response to conventional systemic therapy.

articles.title: BackBox and Nomios Partner to Help Enterprises Accelerate Their Network Automation and Cyber Maturity Journey
articles.mainIdea: BackBox and Nomios Partner to Help Enterprises Accelerate Their Network Automation and Cyber Maturity Journey
articles.summary: PR Newswire: BackBox and Nomios Partner to Help Enterprises Accelerate Their Network Automation and Cyber Maturity Journey. BackBox, a leading provider of network cyber resilience solutions, has partnered with Nomios, one of Europe's leading providers of cybersecurity services. This collaboration aims to enhance network visibility and automation for IT and Security teams.
